title: [v0.92.1][AWS-D] AWS audit and security baseline
body:
## Outcome

Produce one operational AWS audit and security baseline.

## Primary deliverable

One operational audit and security baseline with owned retention and findings destinations.

## Verification result

CloudTrail, configuration, detection, access-analysis, encryption, logging, alert, retention, and redaction readbacks pass for the exact account foundation.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one operational audit-and-security baseline; individual services are implementation parts and cannot close independently.

## Dependencies

- AWS-C: #486

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Account changes are durably observable
- [ ] Security findings have an owner and destination
- [ ] Retention and encryption are explicit
- [ ] Sensitive values are excluded from retained proof

## Owned paths

- `infra/aws/account-foundation/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/aws/audit-security/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-d/**`

## PVF lanes

- `audit-coverage`
- `detection-readback`
- `retention`
- `alert-routing`
- `redaction`

## Stop conditions

- Audit gaps remain unexplained
- Findings lack ownership
- Logging creates uncontrolled cost

## Non-goals

- Multi-account rollout
- Application security redesign
